title: Pure Floowandereeze
summary: Pure Floowandereeze Tribute Summon control build, relying strictly on sequential Normal Summons rather than Special Summons. The Level 1 migratory birds cycle from the banishment back to the hand, chain-summoning Level 10 Winged Beast bosses that floodgate opponent monster effects and disrupt plays on both turns.

summary.title: Starters & Chain Summons
points: Floowandereeze & Robina searches a Level 4 or lower Winged Beast (usually Eglen) on Normal Summon and immediately grants an additional Normal Summon.
Floowandereeze & Eglen searches a Level 7 or higher Winged Beast (such as Empen or Snowl) and immediately grants a Tribute Summon.
Floowandereeze & Stri banishes a card from either graveyard to trigger banished birds, granting an immediate Normal Summon.
Floowandereeze & Toccan targets and recovers a banished Floowandereeze card to the hand, granting an immediate Normal Summon.
Every Level 1 bird banishes itself when it leaves the field face-up, and returns to the hand whenever another Winged Beast is Normal Summoned.

summary.title: Opening: Robina
steps: Normal Summon Floowandereeze & Robina to search Floowandereeze & Eglen from your Deck.
Use Robina's additional Normal Summon to summon Floowandereeze & Eglen.
Activate Eglen to search Floowandereeze & Empen; Robina in banishment triggers to return itself to your hand.
Tribute Summon Floowandereeze & Empen using Robina and Eglen (Eglen also returns to your hand).
Empen searches Floowandereeze and the Dreaming Town (or Floowandereeze and the Magnificent Map) from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Floodgates
points: Floowandereeze & Empen prevents the opponent from activating the effects of Special Summoned monsters in Attack Position, and halves an attacking monster's ATK/DEF by banishing a card from your hand.

Floowandereeze & Snowl grants up to three Normal Summons during the turn it is Tribute Summoned, inflicts piercing damage, and flips all opponent Special Summoned monsters face-down as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Floowandereeze and the Magnificent Map reveals a bird in hand to banish a different one from the Deck and immediately Normal Summon the revealed bird, triggering on your turn or when the opponent Normal Summons.
Floowandereeze and the Advent of Adventure banishes a Winged Beast from hand or field to add a Floowandereeze monster or Field Spell to hand, gaining 500 LP and dodging targeted negation.
Floowandereeze and the Unexplored Winds lets you send an opponent's card to the GY as material for a 2-Tribute Tribute Summon without destroying or targeting it.
Floowandereeze and the Dreaming Town allows a Tribute Summon during the opponent's Main Phase, and banishes itself from the GY to book all opponent monsters if a Level 7+ monster is Tribute Summoned.

Floowandereeze and the Scary Sea is a Counter Trap that negates an opponent's Special Summon while you control a Tribute Summoned monster, returning it to hand and locking the opponent out of Special Summons for the turn.
